$description: Northway visual v3. Approved white canvas, grey elevated objects, pine bands. See v2/VISUAL-V3-BUILD-CONTRACT.md.

primitive.$description: Tier 1. Raw values. Components never bind here , only to semantic or component tokens.

white.$description: On-accent and inverse text. 17.40:1 on ink, 21:1 on black. Never used as text on the canvas (1.39:1 , fail). CSS: oklch(1.000 0.0000 0.0). Hex: #FFFFFF.

black.$description: Inverse band background. Board: inverse is black, not navy. Also accent hover and pressed. CSS: oklch(0.000 0.0000 0.0). Hex: #000000.

danger-border.$description: Danger edge. 3.35:1 on canvas, 3.77:1 on muted, 4.18:1 on raised. CSS: oklch(0.570 0.0899 27.4). Hex: #A6625A.

success-border.$description: Success edge. 3.56:1 on canvas, 4.00:1 on muted, 4.44:1 on raised. CSS: oklch(0.538 0.0700 152.1). Hex: #4E7A5A.

warning-border.$description: Warning edge. Same as the icon, 4.06:1 on canvas, 4.74:1 on muted. CSS: oklch(0.520 0.0903 67.7). Hex: #8B5E29.

warning-text.$description: Warning and sample message text. 6.77:1 on warning muted, 6.46:1 on sample fill, 5.79:1 on canvas. CSS: oklch(0.435 0.0823 75.8). Hex: #6B4A12.

sample-fill.$description: Sample badge fill. Must stay obvious. CSS: oklch(0.926 0.0413 90.3). Hex: #F1E6C8.

overlay.$description: Mobile nav and dialog backdrop. CSS: oklch(0.000 0.0000 0.0 / 0.48). Hex: #000000 at 48%.

12.$description: Section padding on mobile and tablet. Andersen uses 96px almost everywhere.

16.$description: Section padding from 1024. 32px more open than Andersen, closer to AREA 17 and Gretel.

24.$description: Home hero top padding from 1024. Andersen measured 192px. Clears the 68px sticky nav.

target.$description: Minimum target. Locked by UX Lead. Floor, not an 8pt multiple.

nav.$description: Nav height and scroll-padding-top. Locked. Not Clay's 110 or Halston's 48.

icon.$description: Phosphor Regular icon size, optically aligned to the 8pt grid.

none.$description: Photographs, full-bleed bands, comparison tables, work cards. Andersen and Gretel: low-chrome images.

md.$description: Optional on quiet cards. Prefer none or sm on case cards.

pill.$description: Every button, including inverse and brand-band CTAs. UX Lead, locked.

semibold.$description: Nav current, selected chips, FAQ open. The non-colour cue.

fast.$description: Colour and opacity on hover, focus, pressed. Locked.

default.$description: Optional one-time section reveal, opacity only. Never on every block.

standard.$description: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1). Ease-out. No springs, no overshoot past 1. Build-ready spec.

hover.$description: Maximum card hover translate. Fine pointer only.

rest.$description: Optional, very faint, cards only. The references are mostly still and flat.

hover.$description: Case cards, fine pointer, 120ms. No glow, no coloured shadow.

measure.$description: Posts, legal, long body, section intros. About 640–660px at 16px.

work-gap.$description: Work grid and services offerings gap. Locked. Andersen and Gretel: large images, 24px gap.

semantic.$description: Tier 2. The names components and the build-ready spec bind to. Light mode only. Never raw hex.

disabled.$description: color.bg.disabled. Disabled fill, explicit, not 40% opacity.

default.$description: Semantic name: color.surface. Cards, nav (or nav may use color.bg for a seamless bar, as Halston does), form panel.
color.text. Body and headings. 12.54:1 on color.bg.

input.$description: color.border.input. Tightest UI pair, 3.29:1 on color.bg.

inverse.$description: color.accent.inverse. Optional inverse link. Prefer white.

text.$description: color.danger.text. 7.57:1 on muted. Always with a text message, not a red border alone.
color.success.text. 8.29:1 on muted. Text (and optional icon), not colour alone.
selected.text. With SemiBold, not colour alone.

indicator.$description: selected.indicator. 2px underline or a check. Required.

bg.$description: inverse.cta.bg. White pill. Never an accent-fill CTA on inverse.

brand-band.$description: In this monochrome system the band is ink (#1A1A1A), visually close to inverse (black). The tokens stay separate so a rebrand can colour the band without touching the footer.

strong.$description: scrim.strong. 5.22:1 white over a white photo.

gradient.$description: scrim.gradient. 6.88:1 at the type end. If this fails, use inverse.bg as a solid panel.

text.$description: scrim.text. Only on the strong or gradient end, after a check.

gutter.$description: layout.gutter. Locked. Wide is type-only , no fourth gutter. 16 / 24 / 32.

rail.$description: Component library index width. Preview only.

form.$description: Maximum width for readable field examples.

top.$description: space.hero.top. Andersen measured 192px at the top of the home hero so the H1 clears the sticky nav. Keep this in a token, not a magic number. (Reference board, Spacing and layout.)

gutter.$description: Grid gutter between columns, not the page gutter.

work-columns.$description: Work grid: 1 / 2 / 3. Gap 24. Andersen and Gretel: large, low-chrome images.

type.$description: Approved v3 type roles. Body 18/1.55 at every breakpoint. See the complete build contract table.

size.$description: Helpers, dates, image captions, legal meta. Weight 400. Tracking 0.01em.
Pill labels. Optically centred in 44px (md) or 52px (lg). Weight 500.
Nav items. Weight 500, current 600 plus selected.indicator.

home.$description: Composition tokens shared by visual v3 pages. Surfaces alias the global system.

button.$description: Pine primary on light, white primary on pine. Secondary actions are text. One primary in a viewport.

pad-x.$description: 24px. Visual with 32 at lg is also fine; 24 is the kit default.

bg.$description: Transparent-looking: same as the canvas, or a quiet surface. Outline is the cue. Halston.
No fill. Text and a 44px target.

link.$description: Because color.accent equals color.text, body links are underlined at rest (WCAG 1.4.1). Nav links are not underlined at rest; current uses selected.indicator plus weight 600. Prefer white links on inverse.

underline.$description: Body and footer links at rest. Nav is an exception (indicator on current only).

input.$description: Height 44. Label above, never placeholder-only. Helper or error below. Contact form sits on a light surface, never on inverse. radius.sm.

height.$description: Still sits in a 44px target if it's the only control; in a filter row, 32 with 8px between is acceptable when the whole row is spacious. Prefer 44 when tags are sparse.

size.$description: 24px. Phosphor Regular, MIT. Functional icons only.

focus-visible.$description: Visually hidden until focused. First focusable element on every page.

icon.$description: circle-alert, plus the message , not a red border alone.

case-card.$description: Andersen and Gretel: large, low-chrome images. Client, sector, year, one-line result, image. The whole card is the target. No invented figures. ratio 3:2.

ratio.$description: One ratio across the work grid. Reference board Imagery. A calm 4:3 is acceptable if applied consistently; 3:2 is the default.

min-height.$description: Typographic case card minimum height, without an image placeholder.

price.$description: Same ink. No decorative colour on the price. Hidden when the global price switch is off.

heading-weight-open.$description: FAQ open uses weight 600, not a new colour.

icon.$description: plus, swaps to minus. Under reduced motion: instant, transition-none. No height animation.

indicator.$description: 2px underline. Stada and the spec. Not a filled bar.

nav.$description: Quiet, sticky, solid surface, Work first, one primary CTA. Last Studio's IA is the closest match (Work / Services / Insights / About + Start a project). Height 68, not Clay's 110 or Halston's 48. Insights omitted when empty.

bg.$description: Same as the canvas, like Halston , a seamless bar. A hairline on scroll is optional (color.border.hairline).

hero.$description: Andersen and Gretel: a short typographic promise, one primary, then real work in the same first scroll. Halston: this on a warm grey canvas. AREA 17: the quiet and the scale, not the long manifesto. H1 is about eight words or fewer ('Work that earns the next project.'). The logo stays in the bar.

measure.$description: The lead, not the H1, uses the measure. The H1 can be wider.

number.$description: Quiet index, not a decorative yellow mark (avoid Last Studio).

photo-ratio.$description: Portraits, if any. Hide the whole section when the collection is empty. Include a one-person (solo) state.

testimonial.$description: Real, named, approved quotes only. If the collection is empty, omit the whole block. No placeholder quote, no fake avatar.

quote-style.$description: Hanken italic at Lead size. Attribution in Caption.

enquiry-form.$description: At most four fields: name, email, service (pre-fillable), optional message. Success and error are part of the kit. Calendar hides if no URL. Sits on a light surface, never on inverse.

footer.$description: On inverse tokens. Credit off by default on paid licences. Hide empty contact lines. Nav mirror, email, legal, one-line promise, studio name.

component.$description: Tier 3. Component tokens alias semantic tokens, never primitives and never raw hex. A rebrand updates primitives (and maybe semantic aliases); components follow. Code may bind to either the component name (button.primary.bg) or the semantic name (color.accent) , both resolve to the same value.
